Rumors suggest that Apple will use "iPhone Ultra" as the brand name for its upcoming foldable model, and Mark Gurman says this is indeed the name widely used within the company.

According to reports, the "iPhone Ultra" foldable name is being used internally at Apple

Apple will unveil the long-awaited foldable iPhone at its September event next month.

Since rumors of the first foldable iPhone began circulating, the device has generally been referred to as the "iPhone Fold".

However, earlier this year, leakers began claiming that "iPhone Ultra" would be the name of the product.

Although this cannot be said to confirm Apple's plans, well-informed leaker Mark Gurman posted on X today: "Everyone internally calls it the Ultra".

"Ultra" is a name commonly used by many Apple employees, but it does not mean it is the final brand name.

Apple is known for its secrecy, so many employees are usually unaware of unannounced products unless they are directly involved in the related work.

The use of "iPhone Ultra" internally may simply be because the outside world has been calling this foldable phone the Ultra. But in reality, perhaps only core members of Apple's marketing team and other informed employees know the true naming plans for this product.

What do you think — will iPhone Ultra be the name of the foldable? What other names might have a better chance? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
